opening.argument: The video presents Forsage as a blockchain-based earning opportunity, displaying “100,% income” and “Working and Nonworking income” alongside “No leg maintain” and a contact phone number. The speaker expressly directs people seeking a Forsage plan or application to call that number and offers technical guidance and support toward their success: “If you are looking for a plan for Foursage If you are looking for a right applying for Foursage”. The repeated references to legs, the network diagram, and the businessperson standing before a line of people connect the promised income to a multi-person structure. This is an invitation to join or apply for an earning system organized around participants, rather than an ordinary product or educational demonstration.
